prompt: In what year was the former South Korean prime minister who is from the same clan as the oldest member of the band BTS born?
answer: The former South Korean prime minister was **Kim Hwang-sik**, who was born in **1948**. Both he and BTS’s oldest member, **Jin (Kim Seok-jin)**, are from the **Gwangsan Kim clan**.
